image_description: A yellow traffic light assembly suspended from overhead wires against a blue sky. The unit features multiple signal faces, including standard circular lights (red and amber visible) and distinct arrow signals (white/blueish arrows). The housing is boxy with protruding visors. There are complex overhead utility lines and a partial view of a street pole in the background.

artifact_observations.location: Wire connections at top of housing
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection points where the suspension wires meet the traffic light housing are vague and 'mushy'. The hardware (brackets/eyes) is not clearly defined, appearing fused with the yellow casing.
Some background wires seem to disappear into the sky or intersect with the foreground object without clear occlusion logic, creating slight spatial confusion.
The right-most signal face appears to have a blank or malformed lens cover compared to the detailed arrows on the left, suggesting incomplete generation of that component.
